title: berlin-sustainai-logistics-and-expense-scratchpad
content:
Trip: SustainAI Summit (Berlin) — primary goals: network with EU partners, demo Redwood Dedicated routing, collect feedback on latency improvements.

Dates / attendees:
- Maya Thompson (me) — presenting workshop on model routing (Sept 22-25, on-site 22-24)
- Luca Moretti — customer meetings (Sept 22-24)
- Priya Shah — solutions desk / collateral handoff (Sept 23 only)

High-level itinerary (local times):
- 9/21 evening: arrive (MUC->BER reroute alert: check baggage claim)
- 9/22: pre-conference partner breakfast (8:30), tech rehearsal (13:00), evening reception (19:00)
- 9/23: full conference (booth shift 10:00–14:00, talks 15:30), dinner with GreenLabs partner (19:30)
- 9/24: wrap, follow-ups, travel back 18:00

Bookings & confirmations:
- Flights: LH 2071 (booked via TravelOps) PNR: MX9T4; receipt emailed to travel@redwood.com.
- Hotel: Motel One Hackescher Markt — confirmation 916732; corporate rate applied. Invoice will be e-receipt.
- Exhibit booth: GreenLabs provided standard 3x3. AV order placed through Messe AV (contact: Jens Koller, +49 30 555-0123, jens.k@messe-av.de).
- Local SIM: Telekom prepaid (recommended kiosk: Prenzlauer Berg, Schönhauser Allee 102) — pick up day 1.

Vendor/payment notes (practical reminders):
- Messe AV requires corporate invoice with full company address (no personal name) for reimbursement. Ask Jens to add “Redwood Inference, 120 Market St, SF, CA” to invoice.
- Taxi / rideshare: require driver name + invoice. For Uber/Bolt, download trip invoice PDF; for taxis get paper receipt (stamp).
- Meals: per diem cap 75 EUR/day. If exceeding, write justification in expense note.
- VAT: collect itemized receipts for anything >10 EUR for VAT refund; keep originals. Hotel VAT often included — request full VAT breakdown on final invoice.

Expense coding cheatsheet (for expenso forms):
- Flight: TRVL-INTL
- Hotel: LODG-EU
- Meals: MEAL (attach attendee list if client meal)
- Ground transport: GND-TRNS
- Booth/AV: EVENTS-OPS
- Promo swag: MKT-SWAG (attach PO# if applied)

Estimated budget (rough, EUR):
- Flights x3: 1,500
- Hotel (3 nights): 720
- Booth AV + power: 1,100
- Meals + misc: 450
- Local transport: 200
- Total estimate: ~3,970 EUR (keep cushion for VAT differences)

Receipts checklist (before submitting):
- PDF/scan all receipts within 7 days of return.
- For cash purchases: photo of paper receipt + card statement showing conversion if paid by corporate card.
- For multi-day hotel: get final invoice with night-by-night breakdown + VAT.
- Conference registration: PDF invoice with VAT number and event organizer name (GreenLabs GmbH, VAT DE123456789).

VAT refund quick steps (Berlin/EU):
1) Keep original receipts and stamped export forms for EU non-residents (if applicable).
2) For goods bought in EU to export, ask retailer for Tax Free form.
3) At airport, allow extra 30–45 mins for VAT stamping pre-security.
4) Submit refund paperwork at departure desk or use Global Blue kiosk (check whether kiosk supports German VAT).

Pre-trip to-dos (me):
- [ ] Confirm AV invoice will be in English and include company address — ACTION: email Jens K. (by 2025-09-15).
- [x] Submit travel request to TravelOps (approved 2025-09-13).
- [ ] Upload workshop slide deck to share drive and create 1-page demo cheat sheet for booth (owner: Maya, due 9/18).
- [ ] Reserve booth collateral shipping (ask Logistics for pallet pickup day).
- [ ] Print 20 business cards and 200 postcard one-pagers (Priya to coordinate).

At-conference quick reminders:
- Carry stamped business cards for VAT forms? (no, but keep contact info sheet for sales).
- Keep one backup EU adapter (Type C) and USB-C charging hub.
- Bring HDMI->USB-C dongle for demo laptop.
- Keep demo token and local model bundle on encrypted USB; test offline.

Unresolved questions / risks:
- Messe AV asked for 50% deposit info — TravelOps to confirm payment method (wire vs card).
- Possible flight rebooking due to weather — do we have travel insurance? TravelOps says yes, basic coverage; consider upgrade? (Luca to check).
- Will conference wifi allow WebSocket streaming for live demo? If not, need tethering plan and local VM of model.

Action items with owners:
- Jens K. (Messe AV) — send final invoice with company address (Maya)
- Priya — print collateral and coordinate booth staffing schedule (due 9/18)
- Luca — confirm travel insurance details and backup flight options (due 9/16)
- TravelOps (travel@redwood.com) — confirm deposit/payment instructions for AV (cc: maya)

Post-trip submission notes (how I will do expense):
- Upload all PDFs to Expensify project: "BER-SUSTAINAI-2025" within 7 days.
- Attach Confluence note summarizing customer interactions and leads (tag: sales-leads).
- Annotate any over-cap items with justification and attach host/attendee list for client meals.

Random personal admin reminders:
- Bring copy of passport + one scanned to drive (encrypted link only).
- Keep receipts in a single envelope sorted by category (hotel on top).
- If any receipts are handed to me by partners, log who gave them and for what.

Notes / freeform:
- Consider small giveaway: 50 stickers + 30 microfiber laptop sleeves (estimate cost ~400 EUR) — good for lead magnet but heavy to ship. Maybe order local print run in DE.
- Quick pitch: 30s demo focusing on routing by latency tiers + fallback to quantized variants.

End-of-trip checklist (to submit):
- [ ] Expense report submitted (Expensify)
- [ ] Confluence trip note + lead list (Maya)
- [ ] Refunds requested for any VAT-eligible items
- [ ] Lessons learned/ops friction logged to TravelOps channel

-- scratchpad end --

(Links: TravelOps Slack channel: #travel-ops; Event page: https://sustainai.de/2025; contact: partnerships@greenlabs.de)
